description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveFeatureStrategy class, which handles the RetrieveFeature command in the Ditto framework. It retrieves a specific feature from a Thing, generates a response, and manages entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle RetrieveFeature commands, retrieving specific features from Things and generating appropriate results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the method to process the RetrieveFeature command, extracting the feature from the Thing and generating a result.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts the Features object from a Thing, throwing an exception if not present.

methods.name: getFeatureResult
methods.description: Generates a result containing the feature JSON or an error if the feature is not found.

methods.name: getFeatureJson
methods.description: Converts the Feature object to a JsonObject, optionally selecting specific fields.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag if available, delegating to nextEntityTag.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag for the specified feature in a Thing.
